description: This file defines an abstract base class for launching and managing applications, specifically for Cobalt development tools, including platform-specific launcher creation, target status enumeration, and launcher interface methods.

classes.name: TargetStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing the status of a target process (OK, NA, CRASH, NOT_STARTED).

classes.name: AbstractLauncher
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface and common behavior for application launchers in the Cobalt project.

methods.name: _GetLauncherForPlatform
methods.description: Retrieves the platform-specific launcher module based on platform name.

methods.name: LauncherFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a launcher instance for a specified platform and configuration.

methods.name: TargetStatus.ToString
methods.description: Converts a TargetStatus enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.__init__
methods.description: Initializes launcher with platform, target, configuration, device ID, and optional parameters.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.HasExtendedInterface
methods.description: Checks if the launcher supports extended interface methods like Run2.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.Run
methods.description: Abstract method to run the application; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.GetDeviceIp
methods.description: Abstract method to get device IP; must be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Abstract method to get writable output path on device; must be implemented.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SupportsSuspendResume
methods.description: Indicates if suspend/resume signals are supported; defaults to False.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendResume
methods.description: Sends resume signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendSuspend
methods.description: Sends suspend signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendConceal
methods.description: Sends conceal signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendFocus
methods.description: Sends focus signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendFreeze
methods.description: Sends freeze signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SupportsDeepLink
methods.description: Indicates if deep linking is supported; defaults to False.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendDeepLink
methods.description: Sends deep link; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SupportsSystemSuspendResume
methods.description: Indicates if system suspend/resume signals are supported; defaults to False.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendSystemResume
methods.description: Sends system resume signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.SendSystemSuspend
methods.description: Sends system suspend signal; raises error if not supported.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.GetStartupTimeout
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration before launcher times out.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.GetHostAndPortGivenPort
methods.description: Returns host and port tuple for connecting to services on device.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.CreateDeviceToHostTunnel
methods.description: Creates a tunnel from device to host; default implementation returns False.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.RemoveDeviceToHostTunnel
methods.description: Removes device-to-host tunnel; default implementation returns False.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.GetTargetPath
methods.description: Constructs default path to executable target.

methods.name: AbstractLauncher.GetInstallTargetPath
methods.description: Constructs default path to installed executable target.
